full_judgment: 8. In Bangladesh Vs. lsrail Ali & others 1981 BLD (AD) 371 a question was asked whether the plaintiffs' assertions that they successively took yearly lease till 1950 and paid rent revenue up to 1956 could make out a case of tenancy right. After considering 25 DLR (SC) 90 and 1979 BCR (Vol. 3) 400 it was held that before passing an ex parte decree it was incumbent on the trial Court to see whether such facts confer legal right on the plaintiffs against the Government. As the brief finding recorded by the trial Court did neither satisfy the legal requirements nor from such finding the alleged case of the plaintiffs' was proved, the ex parte decree was set aside.
